text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, walnuts are on sale. That's kinda
rare.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This's gotta be a sign! I should make mamebu stew!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta make the walnut dumpl'ns,
then cut up
some burdock root, shimeji
mushrooms, and a
carrot...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's so much work. Maybe I'll just buy
some
hojicha and make roasted tea
porridge...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seems to be feeling worn
out. I
should probably adjust her race
schedule.
